description: P2 CPU-only program-fuzz scenario: the pinned Ibex RVFI CPU model, host RAM, no target IP/DMA. The CPU artifact is resolved from configs/cpus/ibex_rvfi_local/component_profile.json (rendered, matched by artifact_digest, built on a miss) instead of pointing at a prebuilt cache entry. --fuzz generates a different RV32 program per case and executes it; the data-only shape stays available as --fuzz-mode data.
